source.prompt:
Create one wordmark logo for Logo Land. Industry: conversational logo design toolkit. Audience: designers and makers.
Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'LOGO LAND'. Exact slogan: ''.
Styles: custom playful geometric lettering. Original brief palette context: #17352B, #B9F582, #B9A4FF, Solid background #17352B.
Avoid: mockup, watermarks, unsolicited text, existing brand symbols. Use cases: README showcase; brand wordmarks at 240px width or wider; app artwork previews at 64px.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: The lettering IS the identity. Two exact words arranged as two close-fitting lines: LOGO on top, LAND below. Invent massive friendly architectural letterforms with rounded outer corners and precise open rectangular/circular counters. LOGO in acid mint #B9F582; LAND in pale lilac #B9A4FF. Both lines equal optical width, nearly interlocking but with clear readable separation. A distinctive rectangular cut in the G echoes the L corner. Bright flat fills on deep forest ink #17352B. Beautiful independent studio identity, mature and confident yet playful. Entire composition a compact centered block with 15% safe margins. No separate emblem, no small tagline, no framing shape, no trademark sign. Square canvas. Exact content L O G O then L A N D. No bevels, gradients, textures or shadows.. Assumptions: Fictional demonstration requested by the user; one original per showcase entry., Color values are design intent; generated raster colors are not guaranteed exact..
Render one standalone master artwork, approximately 1536 x 1536 pixels unless the concept requests a wide composition. Maintain the exact supplied text; no other text.

review.reviewer: Codex visual inspection, native original and 240px browser preview
review.notes: The exact words LOGO and LAND read clearly as two stacked lines. Lime-mint upper lettering and lilac lower lettering have open counters, consistent bold weight and wide outer margins on an opaque dark-green square. At 240px the text remains readable. This is a new design, so there is no parent to preserve. Generated colors have slight raster texture and variation; no exact-HEX or strict palette claim is made. The brand name refers to this project; the generic fictional-demo wording in the saved generation brief was used for the sample collection and does not rename the project.

color_method: sRGB to Lab D50; CIEDE2000, ColorAide method=2000
color_limits: Sampled raster evidence, not an exact-pixel, Pantone, or print-proof guarantee.
At most 16384 original-coordinate samples; small accents may be missed.
Alpha-zero pixels are excluded; conformance uses alpha >=250 and preserves white.
Strict evidence needs 128 core samples and at most 10% partial-alpha visible samples.
Restricted fit requires 99% core coverage within delta-E00 <=5; design colors need 1% share.
Locks/required colors need 32 matching core samples and 0.5% core share.
Quantized measured swatches are estimates; conformance uses original sampled colors.
Color roles, lettering, and placement require visual review; histograms cannot prove them.
ROI evidence covers only the stated region; opaque full-image evidence includes background.
Contrast ratios on explicit composited surfaces are guidance, not logo AA certification.
